attributes.name: Minagho
attributes.powers:
Minagho is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits. The difficulty of the check to defeat Minagho is increased by twice the adventure deck number of a random ally from the box.

If defeated by no more than 6, you may succeed at a Divine or Knowledge 12 check to draw the cohort Yaniel from the box.
